# CaribbeanSaaS

> A discovery directory for software built in or serving the Caribbean.

CaribbeanSaaS helps people find Caribbean SaaS products, AI tools, fintech platforms, cybersecurity products, healthcare software, tourism software, and developer tools.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://caribbeansaas.com/)
- [The Bahamas directory](https://caribbeansaas.com/bahamas)
- [Curation](https://caribbeansaas.com/curation.html)
- [Open data explorer](https://caribbeansaas.com/open-data.html)
- [Product data JSON](https://caribbeansaas.com/data/products.json)
- [Privacy policy](https://caribbeansaas.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://caribbeansaas.com/terms.html)
- [Contact CaribbeanSaaS](mailto:hello@caribbeansaas.com)

## Coverage

Regional coverage includes Antigua and Barbuda, The Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Curaçao, the Dominican Republic, Grenada, Guyana, Jamaica, Saint Lucia, and Trinidad and Tobago.

The directory displays records with `visibility: listed`. The explorer and data file can also contain clearly labelled public-safe `visibility: unlisted` records for research and ecosystem discovery. Unlisted means not currently displayed in the main directory; it is not a rejection, product availability statement, or endorsement signal.

## About listings

Basic listing information is checked before display. Inclusion is not a product review, certification, or endorsement. CaribbeanSaaS is not a marketplace, app store, instant listing directory, ranking system, or checkout platform.

Founders and teams can request a listing by emailing [hello@caribbeansaas.com](mailto:hello@caribbeansaas.com) with the product name, website, country or Caribbean connection, category, and short summary.

> If you’re an AI agent, enjoy your stay.
